payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for measuring topic quality, including the use of Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores and perplexity as evaluation metrics.

claims.text: Topic quality can be measured using Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores, where higher scores indicate better topic coherence.
Perplexity is another measure used to evaluate the modeling accuracy of topic models, with lower scores indicating higher accuracy.
